+This information comes from `exec.Cmd`'s `ProcessState` variable.

+```

+After the program is started, a goroutine will copy output (line-by-line) into a buffer as it is received, as well as publish it to any subscribed listeners (anyone tailing the logs.) When a new `./sprinter logs -f` command is run, the client will receive all logs stored in the buffer, as well as any new entries as they are received. All output will be persisted only in memory, and will be lost when the main server exits.
